slides.headline: 4.8 million children died before age 5
slides.subline: **That was 2023,** the latest UN estimate. The trend is more hopeful.

slides.body: In **2023**, an estimated [[4.8 million]] children died before their fifth birthday, the UN Inter-agency Group (UN IGME) says.
About **2.3 million** of them were newborns. Nearly half of all under-five deaths happen in the [[first 28 days]] of life.
Since **2000**, the global under-five death rate has fallen by [[52%]]. Millions more children now survive.
Progress is **slowing**: since 2015 the yearly rate of decline is [[42% slower]] than in 2000-2015, the UN warns.
